subject: Pricing follow-up & budget validation - Redwood pilot
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
To: Priya Sharma <priya@acmecorp.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-02-25T14:32:00-08:00
Subject: Pricing follow-up & budget validation - Redwood pilot

Hi Priya —

Thanks again for the time earlier. Quick recap from our discovery and a couple of follow-up asks so we can scope pricing and procurement correctly: 

Summary of what we heard on the call:
- Primary use: customer support augmentation (generation + reranking) for two product lines.
- Expected steady-state throughput: ~1–3M input+output tokens/month in month 1–3, with potential to scale to 8–10M in Q3 if results look good.
- Latency SLO: 300–500ms p95 for typical 512-token prompts.

As we discussed, to give you an accurate pilot estimate we need to validate: 
1) Target monthly spend band (ballpark $/month) to align on a pilot size we can support without procurement/legal friction.
2) Procurement thresholds: at what annual/one-time spend does Acme require an SOW, PO, or legal review? Any specific payment terms (Net30/Net45) or PO limits to flag?
3) Target unit economics: are you evaluating on a per-1M-token cost target (e.g., $/1M tokens) or on a $/month budget? If you have a target $/1M tokens that would be helpful.

Next steps from our side: once we get the band and procurement thresholds, Rishi will prepare a tailored 60–90 day pilot pricing estimate (including a recommended model variant and token assumptions). Laura can attach a standard SOW template if procurement will need it.

I’ve included our suggested high-level options below to give a sense of pricing scale (these are illustrative; Rishi will produce a line-item XLS):
- Pilot Lite: 1M tokens/mo — $2k–$4k/mo (baseline open-model pricing, no reserved capacity)
- Pilot Standard: 3M tokens/mo — $6k–$10k/mo (volume discount, batching, basic SLA)
- Pilot Scale: 8M+ tokens/mo — $15k–$35k/mo (reserved capacity option & deeper discount)

Can you confirm the monthly spend band you’re comfortable with for a pilot and the procurement thresholds we should plan for? If easier, reply with ranges (e.g., <$5k, $5–25k, $25k+).

Thanks — looking forward to aligning.

Best,
Aditya Rao
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: redwood_pricing_estimate_v2.xlsx (pricing estimate stub)]

From: Priya Sharma <priya@acmecorp.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-02-27T09:18:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Pricing follow-up & budget validation - Redwood pilot

Aditya —

Thanks for the recap — that matches our notes. A few answers below: 

1) Budget band for pilot: we’re looking at a pilot budget in the $5k–$15k/month range. We’d like to start conservatively (~1–3M tokens/mo) with the option to expand quickly if accuracy/latency meet expectations.
2) Procurement thresholds: our procurement team can process up to $25k TCV on a standard PO/Net30 without legal review. Anything >$25k TCV or involving data residency/SLA changes will require SOW + legal review (2–3 weeks).
3) Unit economics: we generally evaluate on $/1M tokens when comparing vendors. Our internal target for evaluation purposes is roughly $5k–$12k per 1M tokens — I realize that’s a wide band since internal models vary; this is the stakeholder target when factoring in end-to-end product costs.

Procurement contact: Tina Lee (tina.lee@acmecorp.com), she manages vendor onboarding and PO issuance.

If you can send the XLS with the scenarios (including per-1M token pricing) and a short SOW outline, we’ll route to procurement and come back with a decision timeline.

Thanks — Priya
Sr. Product Manager, Acme Corp

From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
To: Priya Sharma <priya@acmecorp.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-03-01T11:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Pricing follow-up & budget validation - Redwood pilot

Priya — thanks, that’s super helpful.

I’ve attached an updated estimate (redwood_pricing_estimate_v2.xlsx) and summarized three concrete per-1M-token pricing scenarios below to map to the bands you shared. These already factor in batching, typical prefix caching, and a pilot discount: 

Scenario A — Pilot Lite (1M tokens/mo)- List: $7,500 / 1M tokens- Typical discounted pilot: $4,500 / 1M tokens- Estimated monthly: ~$4.5k (fits the <$5k band)

Scenario B — Pilot Standard (3M tokens/mo)- List: $6,000 / 1M tokens- Pilot discount: $3,500 / 1M tokens- Estimated monthly: ~$10.5k (fits the $5k–$15k band)

Scenario C — Pilot Scale (8M tokens/mo)- List: $5,000 / 1M tokens- Reserved-capacity price: $2,200 / 1M tokens (requires 3mo+ commit)- Estimated monthly: ~$17.6k (outside pilot band unless you opt to scale)

Notes and assumptions:
- Pricing shown is illustrative per-1M-token of combined input+output. Embeddings or specialized model variants may be priced separately.
- Pilot discounts and credits are commonly applied; for example we can offer a one-time $5k pilot credit for the first 60 days to de-risk evaluation.
- Procurement thresholds are understood; we’ll keep initial pilot TCV under $25k to avoid legal review if that’s the preferred path.

Next steps I suggest:
- You confirm which Scenario (A/B/C) you want us to price formally in the XLS.
- We’ll prepare an SOW draft (Laura will attach) and a short PO-friendly quote submittable to Tina.
- Rishi will be on the kickoff to validate model choice & latency assumptions.

If you’d like, we can schedule a 30-minute follow-up this week to finalize the pilot band.

Thanks — copying Laura for the SOW template and Rishi for any technical clarifications.

Best,
Aditya
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: redwood_pricing_estimate_v2.xlsx (updated with per-1M token scenarios)]

From: Priya Sharma <priya@acmecorp.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Tina Lee <tina.lee@acmecorp.com>
Date: 2026-03-04T09:15:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Pricing follow-up & budget validation - Redwood pilot

Aditya —

Thanks for the clear scenarios. After a quick sync with product leadership, we’re comfortable targeting Scenario B as our pilot (3M tokens/mo target) with an initial budget of ~$10k/month. That keeps us under the $25k procurement threshold for the pilot TCV and should be fast to approve.

Please go ahead and: 
- Share the formal line-item quote suitable for Tina/Tina’s PO process (Net30).
- Send the SOW draft so our legal can take a look — we’ll flag anything that triggers the >$25k review, but plan to keep it below that.
- We’ll plan to start the pilot the week of 3/22 if the SOW/PO aligns.

Tina — I’ve looped you in for PO next steps.

Action items we have on our side: procurement will review quote and aim to turn the PO within 7–10 business days.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Best,
Priya
Sr. Product Manager, Acme Corp
